other_risks: data poisoning, prompt injection and model theft

mentioned.quote: Risks stemming from possible malicious use of foundation AI models, such as generating content to facilitate cybercrime or child sexual exploitation
mentioned.note: Also 'Malware code' row of the harms table, p.8. Judgement: cybercrime and malware misuse counted as offensive cyber; 'cyber risks' to Cohere's own systems (p.9) ignored.

threshold.note: No capability level or trigger for this risk. Severity ratings p.8 are an 'illustrative assessment' (p.7) with no change in action.

response.note: Generic mitigations only: blocklists and classifiers for 'unsafe outputs' (p.13, stated as 'Key Mitigations We Apply', no binding verb) and revoking abusive accounts 'where Cohere has direct visibility' (p.12, hedged, not cyber-specific).

acc_decider.note: nothing to decide for this risk. Chief Scientist is final authority on release readiness (p.15) but nothing for this risk's threshold or response.

acc_external.note: No cyber threshold, response or safeguards to review. Third-party penetration testing (p.10, p.16) covers containers and models' security; red teaming by external parties 'may' occur (p.16).
